policy.title: Return window
policy.text: Items may be returned within 30 days of delivery.

policy.title: Condition
policy.text: Items must be returned in resalable condition with all accessories and packaging inserts.

policy.title: Inspection
policy.text: Every return routed to an inspection bench is opened on camera before any refund is issued.

policy.title: Kits
policy.text: Each component of a kit is listed as its own line on the packing slip.

policy.title: Complete kits
policy.text: A kit is refunded in full only when every component listed on the packing slip is returned.

policy.title: Incomplete kits
policy.text: When a kit component is missing, the refund is held for review. A reviewer may approve a partial refund equal to the kit price less the list price of each missing component.

policy.title: Serialised components
policy.text: A serialised component must carry the serial recorded on the packing slip.

policy.title: Holds are not denials
policy.text: A held refund is not a denial. The customer is told what was not observed and may respond within 14 days.

policy.title: Refund method
policy.text: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method.
